summary: Full-stack testing of new Admin CMS + Auth + Upload feature on The Bullet Zone. Backend: 16/16 pytest passing (auth login/me, wrong-password 401, protected-endpoint 401 guards for /bookings, PUT /content, /content/reset, /auth/users [GET&POST], /admin/upload; GET /api/content public with all sections; PUT /content persists and reset restores; image upload -> /api/files/{path} returns 200 with image content-type; non-image rejected 400; bookings CRUD; admin users create/duplicate/self-delete/last-admin guard). Frontend E2E (desktop): /admin redirects to /admin/login when not authenticated; wrong password stays on login; correct login sets tbz_token in localStorage and lands on /admin; edited business tagline saved via PUT /content, immediately reflected on public Home; Bookings and Admins panels load; adding a new admin (E2E Admin) appears in the list and deletion works; Reset to defaults restores original tagline; Logout clears tbz_token and returns to /admin/login. Public regression: all 9 pages (/, /about, /services, /models, /modifications, /accessories, /gallery, /book-service, /contact) render, zero JS console errors, no 'Closed' text present.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py seed_admin correctly updates password_hash if ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env changed (idempotent). bcrypt hash format $2b$ verified.
server.py: login_attempts lockout kicks in after 5 fails for 15 minutes (429). Tested with a distinct fake email to avoid locking the admin during test runs.

server.py PUT /content does a shallow top-level merge (current.update(input.data)) — replacing a section replaces the whole section object. This is intentional per admin UI which sends whole sections; documented as expected.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is a fastapi/starlette quirk — browser will refuse cookies with wildcard origin. Not a bug here because auth uses Bearer token from localStorage, but flag: if cookie-auth is ever added, set explicit origins.
storage.py init runs on startup; if it fails, upload endpoint will 502. Startup log currently shows 'Object storage initialized' successfully.
seed_data_creation: Test bookings and one E2E admin user were created and cleaned up during tests. POST /api/content/reset was called at the end of E2E to restore default content.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: run `python -m pytest backend/tests/ -o addopts='' -v`. All CMS endpoints work as documented. Admin dashboard testids match spec (admin-nav-*, biz-*, admin-new-*, admin-user-*, admin-save-btn, admin-logout, admin-reset). Content is reset to defaults after the last run so live site shows original tagline 'Complete Royal Enfield Care Under One Roof'. Image upload works via multipart POST /api/admin/upload and files served publicly via GET /api/files/{path}.
